name: kconmon-ng-openapi-codegen
description: Isolated dependency tree for `npm run gen:api`. openapi-typescript@7 peers on typescript@^5.x and calls ts.factory through a DEFAULT import, which the console's own typescript@7 no longer provides -- installing it beside the app would either fail npm's peer resolution or crash at generate time with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'createKeywordTypeNode')`. Keeping it in a file: sub-package gives the generator its own nested typescript@5 while the app stays on 7. Nothing here is imported by src/; the only entry point is web/package.json's gen:api script.
